question:
Identify the personality on the basis of the given clues:

i) She is an acclaimed Bharatanatyam dancer.

ii) She is the recipient of Padma Shri 2016 award.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prathiba Prahlad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prathiba Prahlad** is a renowned **Bharatanatyam dancer** from India, known for her immense contribution to Indian classical dance.
 
• She has been an active performer, teacher, and promoter of Bharatanatyam, which is one of the most celebrated forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• She was awarded the prestigious **Padma Shri in 2016** by the Government of India for her contributions to the field of arts.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in India, recognizing individuals for their distinguished contribution in various fields.
 
• Prathiba Prahlad has also played a significant role in organizing **dance festivals** and promoting Indian classical arts both domestically and internationally.
 
• Her work has been instrumental in ensuring that the rich heritage of Bharatanatyam continues to inspire newer generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Padmaja Reddy**__

 __
 
• **Padmaja Reddy** is a prominent **Kuchipudi dancer** from India.
 
• Kuchipudi is another form of Indian classical dance, originating from the state of **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• She is known for her innovations in Kuchipudi dance and her contribution to preserving the tradition of this dance form.
 
 
 
• **Padma Sharma**__
 __
 
• **Padma Sharma** is a notable artist in Indian classical dance but is not primarily associated with Bharatanatyam.
 
• She has been involved in promoting other classical dance forms, focusing on their cultural significance.
 
 
 
• **Aruna Mohanty**__
 
 
• **Aruna Mohanty** is a celebrated **Odissi dancer** from India.
 
• Odissi is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, with its roots in the state of **Odisha**.
 
• She has received numerous accolades for her contributions to Odissi dance, including the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**.
